notes.title: The Apocalypse Begins – Maximum Apocalypse Demo is Now Live! ☣️
notes.content:
[i]The Maximum Apocalypse [/i] demo is officially live as part of [b]Steam Next Fest[/b]! Now’s your chance to experience the thrilling [b]digital adaptation of Rock Manor Games’ beloved tabletop roguelike[/b].

[b]What’s in the Demo?[/b]

🧟[b]Zombie Apocalypse Scenario[/b] – Face the undead across [b]three challenging missions[/b].
🎭 [b]6 Playable Survivors[/b] – Each with unique skills to help you navigate the apocalypse.

[h3][b]New Screenshots Released! 📸[/b][/h3]

Alongside the demo, we’re also unveiling [b]screenshots [/b] showcasing the game’s hand-drawn art style, intense turn-based combat, and immersive survival mechanics. Check them out and get a glimpse of the chaos that awaits!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45046341/f1525dd4c412340195c3398dee092e36630f669c.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45046341/9d874b54263b51cb8aa0899ce3f5580af90333e7.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45046341/52f22378138af0f9684644c688bbb2d9011b6f34.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45046341/f9eff8172bbf0dd78a36e8f62d368e0aa7e5f2fa.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45046341/aa24eabf15861c6c03cb782a851252f456f1d58a.png[/img]

[h3][b]What’s Coming in the Full Release?[/b][/h3]

[b]🚀 12 Missions [/b]– Battle through post-apocalyptic scenarios featuring zombies, mutants, aliens, and robots!
[b]🤝 Local & Online Co-op[/b] – Survive with up to 6 players in multiplayer mode!

[b]Developer Updates – What’s Changed?[/b]

We've been hard at work making the Maximum Apocalypse experience even better! Here's what’s new since the initial beta:

✅ Tutorial Updates – Smoother onboarding for new players.
✅ HUD Improvements:[list][*]Less info overload – Toggle UI elements for a cleaner view.
[*]Survivor context menu – Clearer player actions and interactions.
[*]Dynamic hand animations – Improved card feel and responsiveness.
[/list]✅ Lobby Rework – Easier matchmaking and improved game flow.
✅ Enemy Placement Revamp – Encounters are now more balanced and dynamic.

Play the demo now and experience the chaos of survival! Don’t forget to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2434310/Maximum_Apocalypse/][b]wishlist Maximum Apocalypse [/b][/url] so you don’t miss any updates.

[h3][b]Play the Demo Now!
[/b][/h3]
